name: NIST Secure Software Development Framework (SP 800-218)
note: Practices are assessed by the kind of scan that gives evidence for them, when one ran in the last 30 days.

controls.name: Reuse existing, well-secured software: third-party components are checked for known vulnerabilities
Review and analyze human-readable code to identify vulnerabilities
Test executable code to identify vulnerabilities
Configure software to have secure settings by default
Identify and confirm vulnerabilities on an ongoing basis
